Grant/terminal/CAS/package/runtime receipt joins use final recipe-bound digest; no field is SHA(config) masquerading as member closure.

Reservation must belong to exact original issuer/network. Creator captures and journals exact parent FD identity and exclusive placeholder FD device/inode before bind mount; then exact mount ID and namespace FD device/inode before returning.
cleanup.record_path: Original v225 source-selected held RootJournalSelection directory / remote-network-cleanup / <root-issued 32 lowercase hex cleanup_handle>.json; subdir root-owned0700, record root-owned0600, no caller path. Held journal root FD/device/inode and fixed namespace parent FD are retained.
cleanup.record_validation: Closed canonical JSON, duplicate keys rejected; identity/provenance/network fields immutable. Creation observations null only before their producing phase; fresh tool/readback fields null before cleanup observation. Phase CAS compares prior bytes digest under owned lock, atomic nofollow replacement + file/directory fsync. Record cannot restore live custody or authorize active use after restart. Error codes bounded identifiers without secrets.
cleanup.custody: RootOwnedRemoteNetworkCleanupCustody sealed by original resolver; privately retains exact original lease object/issuer registry, journal root and parent FDs, original network/topology, namespace FD/device/inode, mount ID, placeholder device/inode, exact table/readback digest, adopted source provenance and phase. RootRemoteNetworkCleanupReservation is sealed and registered before effects. Caller maps, copied leases, durable JSON alone, guessed handles/paths or foreign NSS cannot mint custody.
creation_order: retain journal through current genuine v225 source/adoption/core join
reserve durable intent before namespace effect
exclusive placeholder create and capture/journal its actual inode before bind
create namespace and bind actual mounted inode/mount ID
journal created lease and retain sealed cleanup custody before active lease exposure
cleanup_checks: Resolve exact retained original custody and current protected journal/root/parent facts; no fresh active adoption required.
Require member_processes empty after ordinary owned unit/PIDFD verified-dead releases. Never stop or kill members in cleanup; unknown/busy processes preserve resource and journal pending.

Acquire fresh HostToolObservationRegistry.observe_selected_nft_tool(original network) then resolve_selected_nft_tool(handle, original network); verify fresh signed package/release, held installed bytes/dependency facts and original network key. Missing/currentness failure remains recovery-pending.
Check exact held namespace FD/device/inode, exact mount ID/path under held parent and fixed basename, original placeholder identity, host namespace separation.
Read current nft state with fresh tool and require exact original purpose-owned table/ruleset digest before deletion; never infer namespace path or delete foreign table.

Journal cleanup-requested before effect; delete only table inet hermes_installer_private; journal table-removed. Detach only exact owned mount; journal mount-detached; verify revealed placeholder equals captured device/inode before unlink; then close owned FDs and journal complete.

Retry after partial effects only from same retained custody and durable prior phase: absence of table/mount acceptable only if prior own completed phase proves removal. Any unexplained mismatch preserves resources/recovery-pending.
cleanup.forbidden: Do not call verify_root_network_lease or its stop-on-failure wrapper; do not require old lease expiry/current role proofs, renew TTL, overwrite old lease/tool evidence, create namespace, activate role, grant port, flush foreign nft, or kill foreign processes. Current ownership and fresh cleanup tool proof authorize removal only.
cleanup.restart: Lost original retained custody means journaled recovery-pending, not cold import of lease/adoption seals. A separate explicitly reviewed recovery authority would be required; this amendment does not invent one.

private_observation_types.RootRemoteNetworkCreatorObservation: Creator-sealed exact parent FD device/inode, exclusive placeholder device/inode and namespace basename; no caller observations. After mount, namespace FD device/inode and mount ID added by creator.
private_observation_types.RootRemoteNetworkCleanupObservation: Cleanup-owner sealed current tool observation handle/readback digest, exact prior phase and bounded error code; no caller maps. RootRemoteNetworkCleanupPhase is limited to listed phases.
